steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen with the default Auction stage.
Enable eRFX project creation for this tenant.
Allow the buyer to add a vendor during event creation.
Provide the required event title.
Apply an Auction pricing template.
Add the line item to be quoted.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet.

args.goal: on the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes set to None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop when the saved terms configuration is shown

steps.note: Configure and verify the two optional clauses and ensure the mandatory-all switch remains unticked.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Add one QA test vendor for the vendor-side submission.
Publish the configured Auction event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited QA vendor's supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's Auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the first optional clause is visible in the vendor Terms & Conditions block.
Verify the second optional clause is visible in the vendor Terms & Conditions block.
Submit a quote of 100 without accepting either optional clause; successful submission demonstrates that optional terms do not block bidding.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Assert that the buyer sees the vendor's direct response.
